_readme: Thresholds for `npm run balance`. Rates are catch chances from 0 to 1. Change a number here (and say why in the PR), never silence a flag by editing the script. 'fresh' = a player who has just entered the area with the gear listed under fresh[area]; 'endgame' = every trap, base and charm owned, best setup per elf.

fresh._note: traps = every trap the player could own on entering (bought or crafted by then); meant = the trap(s) the area is designed around (commons bands and the cheese check are measured against these); base = the base they bring.

recommended._note: The middle gear tier of the report (section 1b, eddy 28 Nov): the gear docs/WIKI.md has a player aim for in that area, including the optional crafts they can make at that point. Cookie Pantry has no boss, so it is the walkthrough's best bought gear. Endgame is different: an over-ranked player with traps from later areas. traps and bases are candidates (the best combination per elf is shown); charm is the one worn. Not used for flags.

recommendedGap._note: eddy 28 Nov: recommended gear is almost always needed to catch the local boss at a reasonable rate, so a boss must be at least this many points easier with recommended gear than with beginner gear.

commonsBands._note: Catch rate against the area's commons (weighted by encounter weight) with the area's best fresh trap. From docs/DEVELOPER_NOTES.md 'Balance targets per location'. A band is only flagged when it is missed by more than `tolerance`.

elfTargets.why: eddy 27 Nov: about 10% off-type at rank 2 gear
eddy 27 Nov: about 30% with a Carol trap
eddy 27 Nov: about 25% with the best gear

tiers._note: Generic bands per tier for the best setup of each profile. `freshMin`/`freshMax` apply to the best fresh setup (any trap the player could have); `endgameMin`/`endgameMax` to the best setup with everything owned. Elves with an entry in elfTargets are judged by that instead.

cheese._note: A trap the player may own that is not the area's intended trap (on the area's fresh base, no charm) is flagged when it beats the intended gear on commons by more than `margin`, when it is a lower-rank trap that comes within `matchMargin` of it, or when it catches a boss or mini boss above that tier's freshMax.

obsolete._note: A trap is flagged when it is never the best trap among traps of its own rank or lower (on equal gear) for any elf at or above its rank, by at least `minLead`. Starter traps (price null, rank 1) are exempt.

craftValue._note: laterOnly = same-rank gear a player only gets after clearing that area's loop, so it is not in the 'on arrival' baseline of other items. Marginal value of owning an item: mean catch-rate gain (best setup per elf, with vs without the item) over mini bosses and bosses (and over all elves) in areas of the item's rank or higher. An item is flagged when, on arrival, both gains stay under these minimums while it costs `minCost` gold or more, or any material. The lasting columns are informational (later gear naturally replaces it).

_acceptedNote: Flags eddy has reviewed and accepted: { "rule": "cheese", "subject": "Carol Horn in Toy Workshop", "why": "..." }. They are listed in the report but no longer warn in CI.
